title: Brennick Software: m and a review (fictional)

documents.title: Vendor due diligence summary
documents.text:
Vendor due diligence summary: Brennick Software (fictional, authored test material).
Throughout the documents of this review, the Target means Brennick Software. For Brennick Software, employees in FY2024 was 2322 (pro forma (including the planned acquisition) basis). Net revenue retention at Brennick Software stood at 141.6%. Brennick Software had order backlog of €494.8m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Brennick Software, run-rate EBITDA in FY2024 was €66m (reported basis). The earn-out trigger for Brennick Software is understood as follows: measured on EBITDA before integration costs. As to Brennick Software, the deal structure is: asset purchase of the operating business only.

documents.title: Management presentation
documents.text:
Management presentation: Brennick Software (fictional, authored test material).
Brennick Software trades under the name Greywater. For Brennick Software, employees in FY2024 was 3195 (reported basis). Headline purchase price at Brennick Software stood at €217.1m in FY2024 (reported basis). Greywater had capex as share of sales of 10.2% in FY2024. For Brennick Software, annualised operating profit in FY2024 was €52.9m (reported basis). The earn-out trigger for Brennick Software is understood as follows: measured on reported EBITDA. Throughout the documents of this review, "annualised operating profit" means the same measure as run-rate EBITDA.
